Allah swears by the sky and the night visitor.
What can make you know what the night visitor is?
Every soul has a guard over it.
So let the human think about what he was created from.
He was created from a gushing fluid.
That comes from between the backbone and the ribs.
Allah is surely able to bring him back to life.
On the Day when secrets will be examined.
Then he will have no power and no helper.
By the sky that returns rain.
And by the earth that splits open with plants.
This Quran is a decisive word that separates truth from falsehood.
And I am making My plan too.
So give the disbelievers a little time. Leave them for a while.
